jobs.title: Director of Pricing and Business Analytics
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
==================


GFL is seeking a visionary, high\-energy leader with a passion for financial modeling, advanced analytics, and commercial business insights. Are you a strategic leader who thrives at the intersection of complex data, technology, and executive strategy? As the Director of Business Analytics, you will drive our enterprise\-wide intelligence roadmap and foster a high\-impact, data\-driven culture across our fast\-paced, high\-growth organization.


This is a newly created position driven by our consistent expansion, appetite for data\-driven decision\-making, and relentless push for continuous improvement. You will join our leadership team at an exceptionally exciting time as we’ve embarked on our pricing program transformation, placing you at the forefront of this value creating engagement. Working with a "no can't do" attitude, you will translate complex technical data into compelling commercial narratives that shape global corporate strategy and optimize bottom\-line performance.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================


Reporting directly to the VP, Operations Strategy, you will lead a dynamic team to drive performance and deliver value\-added decision support across the business. Key responsibilities include:

  

  

* **Pricing Excellence:** Assess enterprise pricing performance, build advanced pricing models from scratch, identify margin opportunities, and challenge assumptions. Influence Area Vice Presidents and Business Unit leaders to translate analytical insights into actionable strategies that optimize commercial outcomes.
* **Advanced Analytics \& AI:** Champion statistical modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics to transition the business from descriptive reporting to prescriptive intelligence. Accelerate speed\-to\-insight by integrating modern analytics tools, AWS\-native workflows, predictive machine learning, and responsible GenAI/copilots.
* **Strategic Roadmap Development:** Define and execute the long\-term vision for the Business Analytics department. Scale enterprise data platforms and ensure full alignment between analytics initiatives and global corporate objectives.
* **Operational Excellence:** Oversee the full data lifecycle—from ingestion and pipeline collaboration to the delivery of interactive executive dashboards, automated workflows, and high\-impact predictive tools.
* **Data Governance \& Integrity:** Establish rigorous standards for data quality, security, and governance. Define control frameworks and KPIs to ensure business intelligence is accurate, reliable, and meeting compliance benchmarks.
* **Stakeholder Influence:** Partner closely with Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership. Translate ambiguous operational and market questions into clear recommendations, guiding executive partners through trade\-offs with decision\-ready narratives.
* **Team Leadership:** Hire, coach, and retain a high\-performing team of analysts and data professionals. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, analytical rigor, and collaborative business partnering.
  

  

**Qualifications**
==================


* 10\+ years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, or related quantitative fields, including experimentation frameworks, statistical modeling, and time\-series analysis.
* 5\+ years in pricing, revenue management, or applied data science within B2B or service\-oriented industries, with a proven track record of building dynamic pricing and financial models from scratch.
* 5\+ years of people management experience, including structuring team processes for service delivery in fast\-paced environments, presenting to C\-suite audiences, and driving cross\-functional alignment.
* Expert\-level modeling skills and hands\-on proficiency with major BI tools (Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau) and database querying (SQL).
* Direct experience with AWS cloud data environments (e.g., S3, Glue, Athena, Forecast, or SageMaker) and leveraging GenAI/copilots to accelerate insight generation.
* Executive Communication \& Influence: Exceptional ability to distill complex data insights into concise, persuasive presentations for senior leaders.
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen: Deep understanding of operational finance, FP\&A, and business operations, with the ability to link data metrics directly to bottom\-line profitability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or Computer Science required; Master’s degree in a quantitative field highly preferred.

jobs.title: Vice President, Technology Enablement
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **The Klick Group**—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high\-performance, people\-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

**About our Technology Craft**

  

The Technology Craft powers Klick’s platforms, products, and delivery capabilities across healthcare and life sciences. Teams design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and compliant solutions across web, CRM, data, and marketing technologies. By partnering closely with Strategy, Creative, and Client Services, the Technology Craft enables integrated omnichannel experiences that deliver real business impact.

 **Job Description**  

The Vice President, Technology (Technology Enablement) is accountable for the successful delivery of Klick’s core omnichannel technology solutions across a portfolio of healthcare and life sciences clients. Reporting to the SVP of Technology, this role provides portfolio\-level delivery leadership, ensures consistent execution across teams, and builds client confidence in complex, regulated environments. The VP leads through senior Technology Enablement Leads, balancing delivery excellence, operational rigor, and scalable practices as client needs and platforms evolve.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead delivery execution across a multi\-client technology portfolio spanning web platforms, CRM systems, Veeva, and integrated marketing technologies.
* Own end\-to\-end accountability for technology delivery outcomes across Klick\-hosted and client\-managed environments, ensuring adherence to SDLC, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Client Services, Omnichannel Enablement, Strategy, Creative, PMO, and Technology leaders to align delivery plans with business and omnichannel objectives.
* Act as the escalation point for delivery risk, making informed trade\-offs across scope, resourcing, timing, and quality to maintain predictability and client confidence.
* Evolve Klick’s technology delivery operating model by improving governance, forecasting, KPIs, and delivery standards to support scalable, repeatable execution.

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* 12\+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise technology solutions, with accountability for large\-scale, multi\-stream delivery programs.
* Demonstrated leadership overseeing omnichannel technology delivery across platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe Experience Manager, or comparable enterprise ecosystems.
* Proven experience leading through senior delivery leaders and cross\-functional teams, with clear ownership of outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with delivery governance frameworks, including SDLC, portfolio planning, risk management, and delivery performance metrics.
* Strong executive communication skills, including translating technical risk and delivery trade\-offs for senior business, IT, and client stakeholders.

**Desired:**

* Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
* Experience delivering technology solutions within US pharmaceutical or healthcare environments, including exposure to regulatory and MLR considerations.
* Agency or consulting background supporting enterprise clients across multiple accounts and delivery models.
* Experience contributing to growth and solution shaping efforts by assessing feasibility, delivery risk, and execution readiness.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling delivery leadership teams while fostering continuous improvement and operational maturity.

  

**Additional Information**  

This posting is to backfill a role at Klick.  

  

\#LI\-TH1 \#LI\-Hybrid

***Our Commitment to Inclusion***  

  

*Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier\-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.*

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description:
Join one of Canada's fastest\-growing companies and be part of something extraordinary \- welcome to **goeasy**! At goeasy, our people and culture are at the heart of everything we do, and we're proud to be recognized for it. We've earned prestigious accolades such as **Waterstone Canada's Most Admired Corporate Cultures** and **Canada's Top Growing Companies**. We're also honoured to be named a **Greater Toronto Top Employer** and recognized by **Great Place to Work®** as having the **Best Workplaces for Women** \& **Most Trusted Executive Teams**, and included on **TIME Magazine's 2025 list of Canada's Best Companies**. These honours reflect our commitment to fostering an inclusive, high\-performance culture where talent thrives and innovation drives us forward.


As one of Canada's leading alternative consumer lenders, we're passionate about helping everyday Canadians create a brighter future. Our vision is to provide a path to a better tomorrow, today. We offer a full range of products, including non\-prime leasing, unsecured and secured loans, and point\-of\-sale financing through **easyhome**, **easyfinancial**, and **LendCare**.



If you're seeking an exciting, high\-growth environment where your contributions truly matter, we want to hear from you! Join us, and together, let's create a future of financial empowerment.


**About the Role:**

Reporting directly to the Chief Operations Officer, the **Director, Enterprise Risk Management** will play a pivotal role in building and leading a modern, scalable first\-line risk management function to support goeasy's next stage of growth. This leader will shape the strategy, establish risk management frameworks, and partner with senior executives to identify and manage key non\-credit risks, strengthen operational resilience, and enable smarter, risk\-informed decisions. Leveraging data, technology, AI, and automation, this role will modernize how risk is identified, monitored, and managed, helping the business anticipate challenges, drive operational excellence, and scale with confidence.


**Who You Are:**
----------------



You are a strategic and progressive risk leader who brings a strong combination of business acumen, analytical thinking, and hands\-on execution. You have experience building or evolving risk management frameworks and know how to translate complex risk principles into practical, scalable solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.



You view risk management as an enabler of growth, not a barrier. You are comfortable challenging conventional thinking, influencing senior stakeholders, and balancing risk mitigation with commercial priorities. You thrive in dynamic environments, embrace technology and innovation, and are passionate about building high\-performing teams and fostering a culture of accountability and proactive risk management.


**What You'll Do:**
-------------------


* **Build and lead the function:** Establish and mature a first\-line enterprise risk management function, defining its strategy, operating model, governance, and priorities to support organizational growth.
* **Strengthen risk frameworks:** Develop and implement scalable risk management practices, including risk and control assessments, risk registers, control inventories, issue management, remediation tracking, and executive reporting.
* **Drive enterprise\-wide accountability:** Partner with business leaders to establish clear risk ownership, strengthen internal controls, and embed risk management into day\-to\-day operations and strategic decision\-making.
* **Provide strategic risk advisory:** Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, providing insights, constructive challenge, and practical recommendations that balance business objectives, customer outcomes, and regulatory expectations.
* **Modernize through technology:** Leverage data analytics, AI, automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies to identify risk trends, monitor key risk indicators, improve controls, and enable proactive decision\-making.
* **Enhance governance and reporting:** Establish effective governance routines, escalation processes, and reporting mechanisms that provide leadership with clear visibility into emerging risks, control effectiveness, and remediation priorities.
* **Build a high\-performing team:** Lead, coach, and develop risk professionals while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**What You Bring:**
-------------------


* 7\-10 years of progressive experience in enterprise risk management, operational risk, governance, internal controls, compliance, audit, consulting, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or transforming risk management frameworks, governance structures, control environments, or enterprise\-wide risk programs.
* Strong knowledge of established risk management principles and frameworks, including COSO, the Three Lines Model, risk appetite, risk assessments, control design, monitoring, and remediation.
* Proven experience leading teams or functions across risk management, governance, internal controls, compliance, or operational risk.
* Strong analytical capabilities, with experience leveraging data, KPIs/KRIs, dashboards, automation, AI, or governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms to generate actionable insights.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior executives, challenge constructively, and translate complex risk matters into clear business recommendations.
* Experience within financial services, consumer lending, banking, fintech, insurance, payments, consulting, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Relevant post\-secondary education or professional designations in risk management, business, finance, audit, compliance, or related fields are considered an asset.

jobs.title: Senior Director, GTM AI Product Leader
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

We are looking for a Senior Director to own the AI roadmap and strategy for our go\-to\-market organization: Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships. You will partner with our segments and RevOps to decide where AI creates the most value across the customer lifecycle, and work with Engineering to deliver it through a deliberate mix of best\-in\-class SaaS platforms (such as Salesforce, Gong) and custom\-built solutions where off\-the\-shelf products fall short.  



  

You will work with internal stakeholders to define the problems worth solving, prioritize ruthlessly, and measure adoption and business impact. You will be the accountable leader for how AI shows up in the way we sell, onboard, deliver, retain, and grow with customers and partners.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**GTM AI strategy and roadmap**

* Define and own a multi\-year AI vision and a quarterly roadmap spanning Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
* Identify, size, and prioritize AI use cases by revenue impact, productivity gain, cost to serve, and feasibility.
* Establish clear principles for build vs. buy vs. configure, and make those calls transparently with business cases and total cost of ownership.
* Align the GTM AI roadmap with company strategy, revenue targets, and the broader enterprise AI and data strategy.
* Rationalize and govern overlapping tools and prevent AI sprawl across the GTM organization.
* Run discovery, prototyping, pilots, and scale\-up with clear success criteria and stage gates.

**AI across the GTM functions**

* **Sales:** AI for prospecting and account research, lead and opportunity scoring, call and meeting intelligence, deal inspection and forecasting, proposal and RFP generation, pricing and quoting guidance, and rep coaching and ramp.
* **Customer Success:** AI for health scoring and churn prediction, renewal and expansion signals, automated QBR and meeting prep, sentiment and call analysis, onboarding acceleration, and proactive risk alerts.
* **Professional Services:** AI for scoping and estimation, project planning, knowledge retrieval, delivery acceleration, resource allocation, utilization, and margin improvement.
* **Partnerships:** AI for partner identification and tiering, co\-sell and pipeline insight, partner enablement, and ecosystem performance analytics.
* Design cross\-functional workflows that connect these motions, such as handoffs from sales to onboarding to delivery to renewal, so AI improves the whole customer lifecycle rather than isolated steps.

**Adoption, change management, and value realization**

* Own adoption by partnering with Revenue Operations, enablement, and functional leaders on training, playbooks, and incentives so tools become part of daily work.
* Define and report a KPI framework covering usage, productivity, pipeline and win rate, forecast accuracy, retention and expansion, services margin, and partner\-sourced revenue.
* Quantify ROI and report outcomes to executive leadership on a regular cadence.

**Governance, data, and responsible AI**

* Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and IT to set guardrails for AI use with customer and partner data, including access controls, data residency, model usage policies, and auditability.
* Ensure AI outputs are trustworthy and that humans remain appropriately in the loop for high\-stakes decisions.
* Partner with Data and Analytics on data quality, definitions, and a shared source of truth.

**Leadership and operating model**

* Build and lead a team of product managers and business analysts, and influence a broader matrixed group of Engineering, Data, and GTM Operations partners.
* Establish intake, prioritization, and governance processes so GTM leaders (CRO, CCO, Services, Partnerships) jointly steer the roadmap.

Act as the executive\-level voice on GTM AI, internally and externally, including with vendors, analysts, and peer companies.  

* 

  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 12\+ years of experience in product management, GTM operations or strategy, sales or revenue technology, or related roles, with 5\+ years leading teams.
* Demonstrated success owning a technology roadmap that serves revenue\-generating teams, ideally across more than one of Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partnerships.
* Deep working knowledge of the GTM technology stack, including Salesforce and conversation intelligence tools like Gong, and how data flows between systems.
* Hands\-on experience delivering AI/ML or generative AI solutions into production, including a practical understanding of LLMs, agents, retrieval, prompt and workflow design, evaluation, and cost management.
* Strong build\-vs\-buy judgment, vendor management experience, and comfort building business cases.
* Proven ability to drive change and adoption among frontline revenue teams and senior business leaders.
* Excellent executive communication, with the ability to translate between technical teams and business stakeholders.

Analytical rigor and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Prior experience as a sales, customer success, or services practitioner or leader, or in a hybrid GTM \+ product role.
* Experience with Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Agentforce or equivalent AI features), data cloud or warehouse integrations, and Gong or similar conversation intelligence tools.
* Experience in a B2B, enterprise, or professional\-services\-oriented environment with long sales cycles and complex account structures.
* Familiarity with partner ecosystems, co\-sell motions, and channel programs.

Experience establishing AI governance and responsible\-AI practices.  

*

jobs.description:
**Location** Mississauga, Ontario, Canada **Job ID** R\-262384 **Date posted** 26/10/2026
  
Evinova is a health\-tech business within the AstraZeneca Group, created to accelerate better health outcomes by driving digital transformation across the life sciences sector. We bring together science\-based expertise, evidence\-led rigor, and deep human insight to design digital solutions that help healthcare work better for everyone. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, data, and analytics, we are changing how clinical research is conducted, how care is delivered, and how patients experience it, with solutions built to scale and to deliver better outcomes for patients worldwide.


We are driven by a shared purpose: to transform health through data and digital innovation. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to solve complex problems, continuously learning and evolving in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment.


We are seeking a Director, Clinical Development Change \& Transformation Lead to drive the change management and adoption work that turns Evinova's solutions into new ways of working across clinical development. Working within the transformation strategy and roadmap set by Evinova's Clinical Development Digital Innovation \& Transformation leadership, you will lead the day\-to\-day delivery: redesigning processes with functional owners, preparing and equipping the workforce for change, and building the working relationships with Therapeutic Areas and Clinical Operations that turn deployment into real adoption and captured benefit.


You will be a visible, trusted presence on the ground in Mississauga — understanding the stakeholder landscape, running rollout and readiness activities, keeping communication and governance cadences moving, and channelling frontline insight and new ideas back to our product teams. As our solutions mature, you will help turn what works into repeatable playbooks and deliverables that support external customers on their own change journeys.


This is a hands\-on leadership role for an experienced change practitioner who combines clinical development fluency with practical transformation delivery — organized, independent amid ambiguity, credible with senior customers, and energized by turning bold technology into real\-world change.


**Responsibilities**

Change \& Adoption Delivery: Lead the delivery of change management and adoption plans for Evinova's AI\-enabled solutions across clinical development, translating the transformation strategy and roadmap into actionable workstream plans, turning points, and deliverables.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Relationships:** Build and maintain working relationships across Therapeutic Areas, Clinical Operations, and enabling functions (e.g., Biometrics, Regulatory, Medical Writing, Quality). Maintain the stakeholder landscape map, act as a day\-to\-day point of contact for adoption, and prepare and support senior\-level engagement where needed.


**Process Redesign:** Lead process redesign workshops with functional and process owners: document current\-state workflows, co\-design AI\-enabled future\-state ways of working, and drive the actions needed to transition, including inputs to the controlled procedure and training updates that a regulated environment requires.


**Workforce Readiness \& Capability Building:** Deliver role and skills impact assessments, develop and run training and upskilling programs, and help embed responsible, compliant use of AI into daily work.


**Rollout Execution:** Manage rollout execution in partnership with Product, Delivery, and customer teams — wave plans, readiness assessments, training logistics, hypercare, and post\-launch support — and track issues and risks through to closure.


**Communications \& Governance:** Develop and run communication plans and engagement cadences across functions and sites, prepare executive updates and governance materials, and facilitate working groups and change forums.


**Adoption Measurement \& Benefits Tracking:** Track adoption and value measures — utilization, cycle\-time and effort reduction, time\-to\-value, and user satisfaction — build the associated reporting and dashboards, and contribute to benefits validation with Finance against the argument.


Feedback Channels \& Product Input: Run structured feedback channels — user advisory groups, voice\-of\-customer sessions, and adoption analytics — synthesize insight into prioritized recommendations and new ideas for Product, and support pilots and user validation of improvements before scaling.


Playbooks \& External Customer Support: Contribute to and maintain transformation playbooks, toolkits, and deliverables, and support Commercial and Delivery teams in deploying them with external sponsors and CROs on their change journeys.


Change Champion Network: Build and coach the change champion and practitioner network across the portfolio, and lead the matrixed or small\-team resources assigned to change workstreams \[confirm team scope with Talent Acquisition].

* Significant experience delivering change management, transformation, or technology adoption programs within pharmaceutical R\&D, biotech, or health technology.
* Strong understanding of clinical development and Clinical Operations processes, roles, and pain points — from protocol design through study conduct and close\-out.

* Strong stakeholder management: credibility with Director\- and Senior Director\-level stakeholders and the ability to influence across a matrixed, global organization.

jobs.title: Director - Mobile Engineering, Wealth Technology
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 277642
  

  

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture.

  

The Director – Mobile Engineering, Wealth Technology, is accountable for leading the engineering strategy, technical direction, delivery and ongoing evolution of mobile applications and engineering capabilities across Wealth Technology.


This is a senior technology leadership role requiring strong hands\-on understanding of modern mobile engineering, combined with the ability to lead engineering teams and partner effectively with Product, Design, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other Technology teams. The Director will drive engineering excellence across iOS and Android platforms, establish scalable engineering practices, and ensure mobile applications are secure, resilient, performant and positioned to evolve with emerging technologies and customer expectations.


This role will be reporting to a Senior Director in Wealth Technology. Knowledge of the Wealth Management industry, digital financial services and emerging trends in mobile technology is an asset.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Own the Mobile Engineering strategy and technology roadmap across Wealth Technology, covering iOS and Android applications and supporting mobile engineering capabilities.
* Lead the architecture and technical evolution of mobile applications, working closely with Architecture, Product and Engineering teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with enterprise technology standards.
* Provide thought leadership on modern mobile technologies and engineering practices, evaluating new frameworks, SDKs, platform capabilities and development approaches against business needs and enterprise standards.
* Establish and continuously improve mobile engineering standards and guardrails covering application architecture, reusable components, coding practices, performance, accessibility, testing, security and maintainability.
* Drive the modernisation of mobile platforms, reducing technical debt and legacy dependencies while evolving applications towards contemporary native mobile architectures and engineering practices.
* Build strong engineering capabilities across native iOS and Android development, including Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, while ensuring effective integration with APIs and backend\-for\-frontend (BFF) services.
* Champion engineering excellence and developer productivity through automation, reusable capabilities, effective development tooling, code quality practices and continuous improvement.
* Drive mature CI/CD and mobile release engineering practices, enabling reliable build, testing, security scanning and deployment processes across mobile applications.
* Ensure security is embedded throughout the mobile software development lifecycle, working closely with Cybersecurity and Application Security teams to proactively identify and remediate vulnerabilities and manage technology currency.
* Establish strong practices for mobile application reliability, performance and observability, using application and real\-user telemetry to understand customer experience, application health and production performance.
* Drive comprehensive quality engineering and test automation, including unit, integration, functional, accessibility, performance and regression testing, to improve release confidence and reduce production defects.
* Own the technology aspects of mobile production health, including incident response, problem management, vulnerability remediation, resiliency, technology currency and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, UX/Design, Digital and business stakeholders to translate customer and business objectives into sustainable mobile technology solutions.
* Work closely with API, BFF, platform and other engineering teams to ensure clear technical contracts, scalable integration patterns and effective end\-to\-end engineering.
* Lead, develop and mentor engineering leaders and engineers, building a strong mobile engineering community and ensuring appropriate technical depth, succession planning and skills development.
* Establish meaningful engineering health measures, including application stability, performance, automated test coverage, security and vulnerability posture, technical debt, technology currency and engineering productivity.
* Manage strategic technology partners and vendors where required, ensuring their engineering practices, deliverables and technology choices meet enterprise expectations.
* Effectively communicate mobile engineering strategy, investment needs, technology risks, architectural decisions and delivery considerations to senior technology and business stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of engineering ownership, innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across mobile engineering teams.
**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:**

  

* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience designing, developing and operating enterprise\-scale mobile applications.
* Strong technical knowledge of native iOS and Android development, including Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose, and the mobile application development lifecycle.

jobs.description:

**Job Number**26140693

**JOB SUMMARY**

  



Develops and implements property\-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property employees. The position provides the financial expertise to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, creates and executes a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

  



**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

  



**Education and Experience**


* 4\-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 1 year experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.


OR


* Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

  



**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

  



**Assists in Conducting Strategic Planning and Decision Making**


* Assists in the development of means to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.


* Analyzes information, forecasts sales against expenses and creates annual budget plans.


* Compiles information, analyzes and monitors actual sales against projected sales.


* Analyzes differences between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.


* Identifies the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.


* Assists in the creation of the annual operating budget for the property.


* Provides analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.


* Assists in the implementation of a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.


* Ensures a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations and profitability.


* Analyzes financial data and market trends.


* Assists in the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.


* Provides on going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.


* Produces accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

  



**Leading Finance \& Accounting Team**


* Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.


* Communicates the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.


* Oversees internal, external and regulatory audit processes.


* Provides excellent leadership by assigning team members clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.


* Conducts annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

  



**Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders**

* Understands and meets the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).


* Communicates financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.


* Demonstrates an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.


* Manages communication with owners in an effective manner.

**Managing Projects and Policies**

jobs.title: Director, Capital Markets Finance
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship\-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.


At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.


To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com


**What you’ll be doing**

  

As a Director, Capital Markets Finance, you will provide high quality reporting \& advisory support to the Global Markets management team on financial and business performance, planning and forecasting. This includes reporting \& analysis of the financial resources (e.g. revenue, expense, leverage, assets, liabilities, \& FTE), planning and forecasting, performing/providing insights to Actual to Plan and DFE to GL variance analysis, and assessing the financial performance and developing financial plan for initiatives. This role will support Global Equities desks in Global Markets. It is an individual contributor role.

  

  

*At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. You’ll have the flexibility to manage your work activities within a hybrid work arrangement where you’ll spend 1\-3 days per week on\-site, while other days will be remote.*

  

**How you’ll succeed**

  

* **Reporting \& analysis** – Review daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly financial results and provide high quality, insightful and timely analysis of financial performance for Global Markets businesses. Identify opportunities for cost savings and support the effective management of Balance Sheet, Funding/Liquidity and Capital Resources (RWA, Leverage and Regulatory Capital). Ensure that reporting and analysis keep pace with the changing business and environment.
* **Planning and forecasting** – Coordinate and support the development of the financial strategic and business plans for Global Markets. Work closely with business heads, Risk and Capital Management, to ensure reasonableness of market assumptions and impact of expected regulatory changes to ensure successful execution. Understand and review allocations to the business and be able to work closely with the counterparts in other areas of the bank to challenge allocations and ensure they are reasonable.
* **Business initiatives** \- Work closely with the business leader to provide sound financial advice on strategic and tactical initiatives and projects. Provide leadership, accountability and facilitate the implementation of business optimization/process reengineering, and strategic initiatives impacted supported businesses.
* **Collaboration** \- Establish and build healthy working relations and partnerships with the business leaders in Global Markets, as well as peers in Risk Management, Operations, Technology, Treasury and other areas of Finance.
  

  

**Who you are**

  

* **You can demonstrate** a minimum of 5 years experience in a Finance role, have a professional accounting designation and/or a post graduate business degree; good financial accounting knowledge and the ability to comprehend complex accounting issues and summarize them for the business; strong problem solving, analytical, judgment and change implementation capabilities.
* **You act like an owner.** You thrive when you're empowered to take the lead, go above and beyond, and deliver results.

* **You give meaning to data.** You enjoy investigating complex problems, and making sense of information. You're confident in your ability to communicate detailed information in an impactful way.

new_jobs.title: Director of Pricing and Business Analytics
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
==================


GFL is seeking a visionary, high\-energy leader with a passion for financial modeling, advanced analytics, and commercial business insights. Are you a strategic leader who thrives at the intersection of complex data, technology, and executive strategy? As the Director of Business Analytics, you will drive our enterprise\-wide intelligence roadmap and foster a high\-impact, data\-driven culture across our fast\-paced, high\-growth organization.


This is a newly created position driven by our consistent expansion, appetite for data\-driven decision\-making, and relentless push for continuous improvement. You will join our leadership team at an exceptionally exciting time as we’ve embarked on our pricing program transformation, placing you at the forefront of this value creating engagement. Working with a "no can't do" attitude, you will translate complex technical data into compelling commercial narratives that shape global corporate strategy and optimize bottom\-line performance.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================


Reporting directly to the VP, Operations Strategy, you will lead a dynamic team to drive performance and deliver value\-added decision support across the business. Key responsibilities include:

  

  

* **Pricing Excellence:** Assess enterprise pricing performance, build advanced pricing models from scratch, identify margin opportunities, and challenge assumptions. Influence Area Vice Presidents and Business Unit leaders to translate analytical insights into actionable strategies that optimize commercial outcomes.
* **Advanced Analytics \& AI:** Champion statistical modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics to transition the business from descriptive reporting to prescriptive intelligence. Accelerate speed\-to\-insight by integrating modern analytics tools, AWS\-native workflows, predictive machine learning, and responsible GenAI/copilots.
* **Strategic Roadmap Development:** Define and execute the long\-term vision for the Business Analytics department. Scale enterprise data platforms and ensure full alignment between analytics initiatives and global corporate objectives.
* **Operational Excellence:** Oversee the full data lifecycle—from ingestion and pipeline collaboration to the delivery of interactive executive dashboards, automated workflows, and high\-impact predictive tools.
* **Data Governance \& Integrity:** Establish rigorous standards for data quality, security, and governance. Define control frameworks and KPIs to ensure business intelligence is accurate, reliable, and meeting compliance benchmarks.
* **Stakeholder Influence:** Partner closely with Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership. Translate ambiguous operational and market questions into clear recommendations, guiding executive partners through trade\-offs with decision\-ready narratives.
* **Team Leadership:** Hire, coach, and retain a high\-performing team of analysts and data professionals. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, analytical rigor, and collaborative business partnering.
  

  

**Qualifications**
==================


* 10\+ years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, or related quantitative fields, including experimentation frameworks, statistical modeling, and time\-series analysis.
* 5\+ years in pricing, revenue management, or applied data science within B2B or service\-oriented industries, with a proven track record of building dynamic pricing and financial models from scratch.
* 5\+ years of people management experience, including structuring team processes for service delivery in fast\-paced environments, presenting to C\-suite audiences, and driving cross\-functional alignment.
* Expert\-level modeling skills and hands\-on proficiency with major BI tools (Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau) and database querying (SQL).
* Direct experience with AWS cloud data environments (e.g., S3, Glue, Athena, Forecast, or SageMaker) and leveraging GenAI/copilots to accelerate insight generation.
* Executive Communication \& Influence: Exceptional ability to distill complex data insights into concise, persuasive presentations for senior leaders.
* Commercial \& Financial Acumen: Deep understanding of operational finance, FP\&A, and business operations, with the ability to link data metrics directly to bottom\-line profitability.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or Computer Science required; Master’s degree in a quantitative field highly preferred.
